about: The second video's narration, one line per scene (VOICEOVER2.md). `at` is when the line starts, in seconds into its scene, chosen so the words land on the action. `direction` is how to say it. Run `npm run voice2 -- …` after changing anything here.

lines.text: New in Study Stash: diagrams you can play with.
lines.direction: bright, a little proud, like showing a friend something new

lines.text: Your notes come first… and a couple of minutes later, the diagrams drop right into the page.
lines.direction: easy, unhurried; a small lift on "drop right in"

lines.text: Point at a box to see what it connects to. Pin it, ask about it, or step through it.
lines.direction: curious, clear, a beat between the two sentences

lines.text: Then hide the words, and test yourself.
lines.direction: playful, a little challenge in it

lines.text: State machines, sequence diagrams, timelines, mind maps.
lines.direction: brisk, a list on the beat

lines.text: When a lecture describes a drone or a hand, your notes can draw it: detailed, and labelled.
lines.direction: a spark of delight on "draw it"

lines.text: A formula becomes a graph you can drag: watch the sigmoid sharpen… and gradient descent overshoot.
And it's light on your computer: quiet while it waits.
Your recordings still never leave your computers.
Study Stash. Free, for Mac and Windows.
lines.direction: warm and confident, a beat after "Study Stash"
